notes.title: Fernbus Simulator - Update 29 RELEASE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26064558/ce77d3e2bb96ba2c8236ebb96215263770363154.png[/img]

The Fernbus Simulator update 29 is out now!

Amongst others, the update includes improvements of the AI vehicles, reworked bus doors and kneeling, and an upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.27.

You can see the full changelog here:

[b]Changelog 1.29.49151[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced old AI Cars
[*] Added arabic localisation
[*] Upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.27
[*] Various traffic AI fixes
[*] Cockpit buttons are clickable with the mouse in cockpit view
[*] Busses now spawn at the front of the bus stop marker
[*] Wind animation of trees improved
[*] All bus doors have been overhauled
[*] Doors now need to be aimed at properly for interaction
[*] Kneeling has been reworked in all busses
[*] Changes to how the radio works internally
[*] You can now zoom in when walking around
[*] Added Z-axis (height) movement to photo mode
[*] Mouse Control Improvements (please reset gas, brake and steering to use)
[*] Added Cross Selector
[*] Changed reverse camera to monochrome
[*] New default keybinds
[*] Localisation updates
[*] Added Alternative Mouse UI to all busses
[*] Some construction sites have been reworked across the map
[*] Keepbrake ignored on controllers/wheels
[*] Fixed assigning keybinds to d-pad
[*] Fixed destination display in action cam
[*] Fixed Crash with very old savegames
[*] Reduced package size
[*] Fixed wrong materials on roofs and distant buildings
[*] Fixed snow fading away in winter
[*] Partial gamepad support for menus
[*] Art and Level Fixes

notes.title: Update 25 - Officially Released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26064558/020f65dc4f1eeabbcb62a78e8e39dbd2ef0c5621.jpg[/img]

Update 25 has been officially released!

In this update, we have primarily dealt with technical innovations. Thanks to the support of [url=https://gaming.tobii.com/products/]Tobii Gaming[/url], we were able to implement the Eye Tracker with which our players, if they have the hardware, can experience the unique Tobii Eye Tracking.

Furthermore, it was possible for us, in cooperation with [url=https://fanatec.com/eu-de/]Fanatec[/url], to optimize our Fernbus Simulator with the appropriate hardware, the input of the devices now works correctly.

We would like to thank both companies for the uncomplicated and great cooperation!


With this update, we also turned to telemetry and added a first BETA output and input, which we will continue to deal with in the coming updates.
A completely new feature in our game is the shuttle mode, in which you can drive our mini and midibuses.
Last but not least, we have of course corrected a lot of bugs in the map and the buses. You can read all about it in our full changelog:

notes.title: Update 21 - BETA - Behind the scenes
notes.notes:
You may be wondering what we actually did for Update 21 to optimize performance? Here is a good example of optimization work in graphics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dea01f48b1dfe6f9eee92ce0ae112f150fb3b4e2.jpg[/img]

Our programmers have identified various settings of graphical assets, which drag down performance and then implemented these warning symbols. So our graphic artists can now see directly in the game editor which assets still draw unnecessary performance and fix them immediately.

Many assets are instanced and the correction of a single error can remove several warning symbols at once. Correcting these unoptimized graphics assets bit by bit makes performance stay more consistent, resulting in fewer FPS drops, and slightly more performance.

Of course this is not all we have done for Update 21's on Optimization, but hopefully, it will give you some insight into the effort behind the optimizing process of this update.

notes.title: Update 21 BETA - Scheduled for next week
notes.notes:
We're are really close to release the public beta of update 21 for Fernbus Sim. We estimate the build to be ready along the coming week.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/9140f25165b3927b7a63e05bb6bfdb70db652c14.jpg[/img]

As soon as the public beta will be available for download on Steam we will make an announcement.

notes.title: Preview of Update 21: New VDL Futura FHD2 driving physics
notes.notes:
The optimizations for the upcoming update are almost complete and we have already updated the driving physics of the VDL Futura FHD2's.

You can soon convince yourself of the new driving experience of your buses. The public beta of the next update is about to start soon.

notes.title: Preview of Update 21: New driving physics of ComfortClasses
notes.notes:
In the meantime, we have also revised the driving physics of the ComfortClasses.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/818ab42030871d246179d5bc46386a74aeeef59d.jpg[/img]

Thanks to the feedback from our closed-beta testers, we're making a few changes to all of the rebuilt drive physics of the buses, but by and large, the new driving physics and improved performance are already convincing. So we look forward to the feedback from the entire community as soon as we release the next update to the public beta test.

notes.title: Preview of Update 21: New Driving Physics for Neoplan Skyliner
notes.notes:
The main focus of the upcoming update will be the optimization of performance. However, we're also updating the driving physics of all busses in the games, both Fernbus Simulator, and Tourist Bus Simulator.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/94297fa642b35a4e73e239ad24371ee4c6b6b978.jpg[/img]

We've already updated the MAN Lion's Coaches driving physics and now we've completed the update of the Neoplan Skyliner too.

notes.title: Preview of Update 21: New audio options
notes.notes:
For the next update of Fernbus Sim, there will also be new audio options. So, you can adjust the sound volume of the engine, the indicators and much more.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/b8901f422f1dc06a3c216fc7f3fc8f0e86c5dcb9.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/af4151c440d8f11b2fec8d527192d48614e09a00.jpg[/img][/url]

Anything missing in the new audio options? You can tell us in the comments below.

notes.title: Preview of Update 21: New driving physics for MAN Lion's Coach
notes.notes:
We thought we share some news bits with you guys as the next updates for Fernbus Sim and Tourist Bus Sim are taking a bit longer than expected - but hey, that's, unfortunately, the usual case if your digging for performance improvements, they're like rare nuggets of gold. So far we've been able to stabilize the overall performance and improve it slightly. We'll keep on digging until we find the motherload.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/334c6a19bb7e4f146532697ab39aaca363f82fff.jpg[/img]

Anyway, we read the forums here on Steam and Facebook and know that some of you still aren't completely satisfied with the driving physics. That's why we're beginning to overhaul our driving physics vehicle by vehicle for the next update. Of course, we've started with the MAN Lion's Coach.

Stay tuned for more Infos.

notes.title: Update 1.17.17721 - Force Feedback, Seating Positions, and more
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]


The long awaited Update 1.17 is now available for Fernbus Coach Simulator! In this update, we're adding two major and most wanted gameplay features: [b]Force Feedback[/b] and [b]adjustable driver seat position and driver camera[/b].

Along with other fixes, we have added [b]two web radio streams[/b] for your convenience while riding along Germany.

Also, Fernbus Simulator is now also available in Swedish.
Tack så mycket till (SWE)Rasmus för lokaliseringen!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/0e7baa39c7e42370cc3ca6c76c50552d79b9988a.png[/img]


[u]How to activate or adjust your Force Feedback[/u]:
Force Feedback should automatically be activated. If not, you can find it in the Options Menu under Game Options on the very bottom of the list.
[b]You can increase or decrease the following values:[/b]
[list][*]Spring Force - force of recentering while driving
[*]Damper Force - Dampening of the swivel resistance
[*]Road Effect Force - damages on the road and effect of the engine
[*]Collision Effect Force - for the intensity of impacts
[/list]


[u]How to change the seat position and driver camera[/u]:
You can change the seating position and driver camera by pressing the [b]Tab[/b] or Tabulator key on your keyboard.
On the bottom left, you should notice a new button with an icon, which obviously looks like a driver seat with and an eye.
Left click on the button and the menu for configuring your seating position and driver camera will appear.


[u]How to use the radio[/u]:
You can find the keys for the Radio in the Control Settings in the General category.
[b]Radio Hotkeys[/b]
[list][*]Volume Up - [b]Num-[/b]
[*]Volume Down - [b]Num+[/b]
[*]Switch Radio Channel - [b]Num*[/b]
[/list]


[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]:
[list][*]Force Feedback added including adjustment options
[*]Driver seat position and driver camera are now adjustable
[*]Events and vehicle malfunctions should work properly again
[*]Miscellaneous AI fixes in Cologne and Kassel
[/list]

[b]Vehicles[/b]:
[list][*]Interior mirror has been added to all ComfortClass variants
[*]ComfortClass Steam Achievements have been fixed
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]:
[list][*]Web radio streams for Double Bass FM and Flashbass.FM added
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]:
[list][*]The vehicle selection scene now reacts to daytime, seasonal changes, and weather conditions
[*]Street lights, other night light sources, as well as glowing during daytime has been fixed
[*]Lighting at ZOB Berlin has been updated
[*]Vegetation will blend smoother
[*]Several minor to medium graphical issues have been fixed in the game world
[*]Player license plate fixed for cities, e.g. Frankfurt, Stralsund, Usedom, etc.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]:
[list][*]Various performance optimizations
[*]Input devices returning wrong values has been fixed
[/list]


The update is now available for all via Steam. We'd love to hear your feedback. You can leave it in our forums and add screenshots and videos if you like: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1599-update-1-17-17721-feedback-bugs/]Update 1.17.17721 - Feedback & Bugs[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]


The long awaited Update 1.17 is now available for Fernbus Coach Simulator! In this update, we're adding two major and most wanted gameplay features: [b]Force Feedback[/b] and [b]adjustable driver seat position and driver camera[/b].

Along with other fixes, we have added [b]two web radio streams[/b] for your convenience while riding along Germany.

Also, Fernbus Simulator is now also available in Swedish.
Tack så mycket till (SWE)Rasmus för lokaliseringen!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/0e7baa39c7e42370cc3ca6c76c50552d79b9988a.png[/img]


[u]How to activate or adjust your Force Feedback[/u]:
Force Feedback should automatically be activated. If not, you can find it in the Options Menu under Game Options on the very bottom of the list.
[b]You can increase or decrease the following values:[/b]
[list][*]Spring Force - force of recentering while driving
[*]Damper Force - Dampening of the swivel resistance
[*]Road Effect Force - damages on the road and effect of the engine
[*]Collision Effect Force - for the intensity of impacts
[/list]


[u]How to change the seat position and driver camera[/u]:
You can change the seating position and driver camera by pressing the [b]Tab[/b] or Tabulator key on your keyboard.
On the bottom left, you should notice a new button with an icon, which obviously looks like a driver seat with and an eye.
Left click on the button and the menu for configuring your seating position and driver camera will appear.


[u]How to use the radio[/u]:
You can find the keys for the Radio in the Control Settings in the General category.
[b]Radio Hotkeys[/b]
[list][*]Volume Up - [b]Num-[/b]
[*]Volume Down - [b]Num+[/b]
[*]Switch Radio Channel - [b]Num*[/b]
[/list]


[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]:
[list][*]Force Feedback added including adjustment options
[*]Driver seat position and driver camera are now adjustable
[*]Events and vehicle malfunctions should work properly again
[*]Miscellaneous AI fixes in Cologne and Kassel
[/list]

[b]Vehicles[/b]:
[list][*]Interior mirror has been added to all ComfortClass variants
[*]ComfortClass Steam Achievements have been fixed
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]:
[list][*]Web radio streams for Double Bass FM and Flashbass.FM added
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]:
[list][*]The vehicle selection scene now reacts to daytime, seasonal changes, and weather conditions
[*]Street lights, other night light sources, as well as glowing during daytime has been fixed
[*]Lighting at ZOB Berlin has been updated
[*]Vegetation will blend smoother
[*]Several minor to medium graphical issues have been fixed in the game world
[*]Player license plate fixed for cities, e.g. Frankfurt, Stralsund, Usedom, etc.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]:
[list][*]Various performance optimizations
[*]Input devices returning wrong values has been fixed
[/list]


The update is now available for all via Steam. We'd love to hear your feedback. You can leave it in our forums and add screenshots and videos if you like: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1599-update-1-17-17721-feedback-bugs/]Update 1.17.17721 - Feedback & Bugs[/url]


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/40aaa390edf00052312e56cfc3e226c0a67c836f.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/344843676dbb30dd1405b5f488fe0c0847a9a14c.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/8e5bb41032c9dbef356cb1cfc26a98c6eac59512.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/6211c3b3e415f3a49a01f64f09f81cadb0920313.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 1.15.15354 - Fernbus Simulator Reloaded
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/8cb97d982f7c7f62b9f0b06b653357e299d90774.png[/img]

[b]Fernbus Coach Simulator RELOADED[/b] - The [b]biggest update yet[/b] for Fernbus Coach Simulator is now available!

Update 1.15 updates Fernbus Simulator to Unreal Engine Version 4.16.3. This should especially bring optimized loading times. We have intensively worked on the performance of the game and improved it in many situations. Starting with loading times, over lighting and shadow rendering, to overall improvements in frame rates. The SkyDome and lighting systems have been improved with the help of your feedback. Thanks to all for the amazing help! Adding to that, many cities have been updated and partially expanded. The update also includes the brand new city of Stralsund. We've put a lot of effort in proving the AI traffic and adding new features to it. The physics and sound systems of all coaches have been improved as well for a more authentic and realistic experience.

There have been a lot of minor and major additional improvements and fixes, which you can read through in detail in the patch notes.

We hope you will enjoy this update and an overall improved Fernbus Coach Simulator Reloaded!

You can leave your feedback in our forum and add screenshots or videos: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1422]Update 1.15.15354 - Feedback & Bugs - Fernbus Simulator Reloaded[/url]

--

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Texture Streaming fixed
[*]Camera position when pausing the game has been fixed[/list]

[b]Performance Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Loading times
[*]Cities at night
[*]CPU performance
[*]Performance of mirrors
[*]General rendering optimizations
[*]Installation and download sizes reduced[/list]

[b]Controls[/b]
[list][*]Option for linear and nonlinear axis input added. You can find this option in the Game Options under "Speed Dependent Steering"[/list]

[b]World[/b]
[list][*]SkyDome improved
[*]New city: Stralsund
[*]"Rügen bridge" and "Ziegelgraben bridge" added
[*]New road surfaces and according sounds added
[*]Cities updated:
- Augsburg
- Berlin
- Bremen
- Dortmund
- Frankfurt a.M.
- Freiburg
- Hamburg
- Hannover
- Cologne
- Leipzig
- Mainz
- Munich
- Stuttgart
[*]Highway blockages deactivated
[*]Dark tunnel at A9 fixed

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list][*]Lighting updated
[*]Passengers shouldn't spawn on roofs anymore
[*]Flying or stuck parking vehicles should be fixed
[*]Shadows updated
[*]Lights of street lamps and other lamps have been updated
[*]Lights of traffic lights have been updated
[*]Lights of vehicles have been updated
[*]Lighting of crossroads and bus stops have been improved
[*]Lighting in tunnels has been updated
[*]Shaders of passengers have been updated
[*]Sizes of agricultural plants has been updated
[*]Rapeseed shouldn't grow during winter anymore[/list]

[b]AI (Vehicles and Passengers)[/b]
[list][*]Behavior of vehicles in curves and during lane changes has been improved
[*]Behavior of vehicles at traffic lights and crossroads has been improved
[*]The acceleration of vehicles at ascends has been improved
[*]Passengers waiting at bus stops will no longer walk around wildly
[*]Physic of passengers luggage has been fixed
[*]The flickering of braking lights has been fixed[/list]

[b]Vehicle[/b]
[list][*]Vehicle physics has been improved
[*]Field Of View of the driver camera has been improved
[*]Control of the driver camera has been updated
[*]High beam of the coaches has been improved
[*]The interior passenger lights in the rear of the MAN Lion's Coach C has been improved
[*]UVs of the Lion's Coach C has been fixed
[*]The passenger monitor in Arcade Mode will now activate automatically
[*]Improved the overall texture quality of the dashboard textures[/list]

[b]GUI[/b]
[list][*]Incorrect tooltips in Arcade Mode have been fixed
[*]Display of current speed in the HUD should now be displayed correctly
[*]Zoom of the world map has been improved
[*]World map will now zoom on current position of the player[/list]

[b]Saving and Loading[/b]
[list][*]Savegames with a dot/full stop (.) will now be displayed correctly [/list]

[b]Achievements[/b]
[list][*]Achievements for "Taking a Break" should now work properly[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list][*]Added option for Stereo and Surround 5.1 Sound (Standard is set to Stereo)
[*]5.1 sound improved
[*]Sound of the coaches engines and driving noise have been overhauled
[*]Driving noise of various road surfaces have been added
[*]AI vehicle sounds have been improved
[*]Ambient sounds have been improved[/list]


The update is now available for all via Steam!

notes.title: Update 1.15.15354 - Fernbus Simulator Reloaded
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/8cb97d982f7c7f62b9f0b06b653357e299d90774.png[/img]

[b]Fernbus Coach Simulator RELOADED[/b] - The [b]biggest update yet[/b] for Fernbus Coach Simulator is now available!

Update 1.15 updates Fernbus Simulator to Unreal Engine Version 4.16.3. This should especially bring optimized loading times. We have intensively worked on the performance of the game and improved it in many situations. Starting with loading times, over lighting and shadow rendering, to overall improvements in frame rates. The SkyDome and lighting systems have been improved with the help of your feedback. Thanks to all for the amazing help! Adding to that, many cities have been updated and partially expanded. The update also includes the brand new city of Stralsund. We've put a lot of effort in proving the AI traffic and adding new features to it. The physics and sound systems of all coaches have been improved as well for a more authentic and realistic experience.

There have been a lot of minor and major additional improvements and fixes, which you can read through in detail in the patch notes.

We hope you will enjoy this update and an overall improved Fernbus Coach Simulator Reloaded!

You can leave your feedback in our forum and add screenshots or videos: [url=http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/thread/1422]Update 1.15.15354 - Feedback & Bugs - Fernbus Simulator Reloaded[/url]

--

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Texture Streaming fixed
[*]Camera position when pausing the game has been fixed[/list]

[b]Performance Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Loading times
[*]Cities at night
[*]CPU performance
[*]Performance of mirrors
[*]General rendering optimizations
[*]Installation and download sizes reduced[/list]

[b]Controls[/b]
[list][*]Option for linear and nonlinear axis input added. You can find this option in the Game Options under "Speed Dependent Steering"[/list]

[b]World[/b]
[list][*]SkyDome improved
[*]New city: Stralsund
[*]"Rügen bridge" and "Ziegelgraben bridge" added
[*]New road surfaces and according sounds added
[*]Cities updated:
- Augsburg
- Berlin
- Bremen
- Dortmund
- Frankfurt a.M.
- Freiburg
- Hamburg
- Hannover
- Cologne
- Leipzig
- Mainz
- Munich
- Stuttgart
[*]Highway blockages deactivated
[*]Dark tunnel at A9 fixed

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list][*]Lighting updated
[*]Passengers shouldn't spawn on roofs anymore
[*]Flying or stuck parking vehicles should be fixed
[*]Shadows updated
[*]Lights of street lamps and other lamps have been updated
[*]Lights of traffic lights have been updated
[*]Lights of vehicles have been updated
[*]Lighting of crossroads and bus stops have been improved
[*]Lighting in tunnels has been updated
[*]Shaders of passengers have been updated
[*]Sizes of agricultural plants has been updated
[*]Rapeseed shouldn't grow during winter anymore[/list]

[b]AI (Vehicles and Passengers)[/b]
[list][*]Behavior of vehicles in curves and during lane changes has been improved
[*]Behavior of vehicles at traffic lights and crossroads has been improved
[*]The acceleration of vehicles at ascends has been improved
[*]Passengers waiting at bus stops will no longer walk around wildly
[*]Physic of passengers luggage has been fixed
[*]The flickering of braking lights has been fixed[/list]

[b]Vehicle[/b]
[list][*]Vehicle physics has been improved
[*]Field Of View of the driver camera has been improved
[*]Control of the driver camera has been updated
[*]High beam of the coaches has been improved
[*]The interior passenger lights in the rear of the MAN Lion's Coach C has been improved
[*]UVs of the Lion's Coach C has been fixed
[*]The passenger monitor in Arcade Mode will now activate automatically
[*]Improved the overall texture quality of the dashboard textures[/list]

[b]GUI[/b]
[list][*]Incorrect tooltips in Arcade Mode have been fixed
[*]Display of current speed in the HUD should now be displayed correctly
[*]Zoom of the world map has been improved
[*]World map will now zoom on current position of the player[/list]

[b]Saving and Loading[/b]
[list][*]Savegames with a dot/full stop (.) will now be displayed correctly [/list]

[b]Achievements[/b]
[list][*]Achievements for "Taking a Break" should now work properly[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list][*]Added option for Stereo and Surround 5.1 Sound (Standard is set to Stereo)
[*]5.1 sound improved
[*]Sound of the coaches engines and driving noise have been overhauled
[*]Driving noise of various road surfaces have been added
[*]AI vehicle sounds have been improved
[*]Ambient sounds have been improved[/list]


The update is now available for all via Steam!

notes.title: Update 1.13.12452
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/dac8b8708c71d37927a9b826abdcb06c282ce65b.png[/img]

In this update we have included a [b]new lighting system[/b] with Color Grading and Bloom. There is a new category in the graphics options, with adjustments for Gamma, Color Grading and Bloom.

We've invested quite some time on our [b]new NPC models[/b] to make them as performant as possible. These new passenger models also come with all new animations, which we want to expand in the future.

The [b]Kochertal Viaduct along the A6[/b], between Heilbronn and Nuremberg, has been added, including the Kochertal Valley and new resting areas.
We have also changed the look of the street bariers, making them less eye-catching, and we've optimized the [b]traffic light behavior[/b] in all cities to improve traffic flow.

Additionally, several graphical issues have been fixed and new achievements added. The windows of all coaches have been updated, which should fix shading, reflections and Anti-Aliasing bugs and artefacts.

And last but not least, thanks to diligent help the [b]Italian localisation[/b] is now available. Mille grazie!
--

notes.title: Update 1.12.11876
notes.notes:
In this Update, you'll receive some new content and overhauled features free of charge, e.g. the new Sound Engine, which we've been working on for the last quarter. The "break"-mechanic has been improved, and also the A7 has been fully reconstructed. Prepare yourselves for a racy and tuneful Roller coaster ride!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.10.11383
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26064558/98067a40e48ddf7073b9d7a6661d3ace3a8d7afb.png[/img]

Some users reported us they got troubles with their save games and error messages like [b]LowLevelFatalError[/b] which might not start Fernbus Simulator at all with the latest update. We released a new hotfix today which should fix this issue.

If you backed up your old save game, make sure to replace and recover it. For those who started a new game and backed up their save game:
[list]
[*] Open up Windows Explorer and navigate to your local Fernbus Simulator App Data. [b]In most cases: C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\Local\Fernbus\Saved\SaveGames[/b]
[*] If you backed up your old profile, replace Profile.sav. [b]If your file got created prior February 10th, you don't need to make any changes.[/b]
[*]Start Fernbus Simulator, your old save game should work like expected.
[/list]

As usual, if you encounter any troubles with Fernbus Simulator, make sure to reach us out on our official support center (http://www.tml-studios.de/forum/support/) and our community hub for gameplay related issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.10369
notes.notes:
Finally we're back with a new update! This patch includes full TrackIR support, dramatic performance improvements, and we have added stationary buses at some central bus stations. The update is available now!
With several updates that have been released until now, we would be happy to read new Steam reviews based on your current opinion on the game!

[h1][b]Game Engine[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated to Unreal Engine 4.13
[/list]

[h1][b]Input Devices[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added TrackIR Support
[list]
[*]Needs to be activated in Game Options
[*]In TrackIR Software "Check for Game Updates..." have to be executed
[*]In TrackIR Software deactivate "Trap" at all hotkey because this blocks the keys in the game
[*]Press key "Cockpitkamera" (2) another time to center the view
[/list]
[*]Force Feedback in MAN Lion's Coach and Lion's Coach C adjusted
[*]Crash fixed caused through many connected input devices
[/list]

[h1][b]Performance[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Overall CPU performance improved
[*]Mirror performance improved
[*]Coach performance improved
[/list]

[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in "Taking a break". You need to check all passengers inside the coach first, before you can check-in new passengers
[*]Visualisation of Marked Areas updated and added Symbols for Bus Stops, Depot, Gas Stations, Parking and Police Checks
[*]Fixed starting from Depot in Freeplay
[*]Bar barrier fixed
[*]Dashbaord buttons can not be used anymore in Arcade Mode
[/list]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added tool tips added for Dashboard buttons
[*]Leaderboards inside the player profile now show correct
[/list]

[h1][b]Menues[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Saving is now possible, if you deleted the save games name and start writing again
[*]Gamepad and Mouse axis are now able to be added as input
[/list]

[h1][b]Graphics[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Additional Levels of Detail for vegetation and various other assets
[*]Added stationary MAN Coaches at Bus Stations (Berlin, Munich, Cologne, Hamburg und Halle)
[/list]

[h1][b]Vehicles[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Inside mirror activated (when mirror quality at "Epic")
[*]Rear fog light in Lion's Coach C fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.9726
notes.notes:
In today's update you'll find one of the first major overhauls: A completely revised Resting mechanic. Additionally we added some fixes to AI lane changing and spawning, improved the games performance and added NPC state icons.
You can find the full list of fixes and updates in the change log below.

[h1][b]Level Art[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Tunnel Entrance/Exit Collisions fixed
[*]Lighting fixed at certain bus stops
[*]Let's Player ads updated
[/list]

[h1][b]Graphics[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Material fixed of the Police Check Marker
[/list]

[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Resting overhaul:[/b]
[olist]
[*]When driving longer that 4h, you can now take a break after 2h of driving at Gas Stations, Service Areas or Bus Stops with a bonus to statistics, or anywhere else with a malus to statistics
[*]Added preconditions for taking a break: The bus needs to stand still, with engine off, doors opened and driver outside the vehicle.
[*]When rested, you're required to check the passengers and send the passenger count to Central via the "Check" Button in your Smartphone
[*]"Simple Resting" added to Control Mode Options
[*]"Resting Quality" added to Service Statistics
[*]"Missing Passengers" added to Service Statistics
[/olist]
[*]Events fixed (Police Control and Highway Blockages will now appear correctly)
[/list]

[h1][b]Performance[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Technical and graphical performance improvements
[/list]

[h1][b]GUI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Leaderboard position fixed in player profile
[*]Added state icons to NPC (can be disabled in Game Options, with the exception for Resting)
[/list]

[h1][b]AI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Lane changing on Crossroads and in Tunnels disabled
[*]AI Spawning updated at Frankfurt Airport and around Service Areas and Gas Stations
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.9505
notes.notes:
The update today features many small improvements and optimizations regarding the AI. The traffic AI now behaves more comfortable on highways. We also implemented basic force feedback support which is going to be further improved with future updates. In the main menu you can now access the leaderboards and compete with other players. Following you'll find detailed information about the update:

[h1]Input Devices[/h1]
[list]
[*]Basic Force Feedback support (some features will be added in the future)
[/list]

[h1]Traffic AI[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved driving onto the highways
[*]Braking without any reason fixed
[*]Flickering of braking lights while standing fixed
[*]Less trucks on mid lane
[*]Improved lane changing
[/list]

[h1]Menu/HUD[/h1]
[list]
[*]Highscore/Leaderboards added to main menu
[*]New HUD element: "General Information" shows speed, time, next stop, scheduled arrival/departure
[*]Added information of saved games (only for new saved games)
[*]Change weather via smartphone (cloud symbol on the top left corner)
[*]Some menues adjusted for various resolutions
[/list]

[h1]Languages[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added slovak (not officially supported by steam. Only available in game)
[/list]

[h1]World[/h1]
[list]
[*]The lanterns at the depot are switched off at the daytime
[*]The depot is more lit at nighttime
[*]Spawning at certain depots which caused the Lions Coach C to get stuck is fixed
[*]Improved dynamic weather
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.9377
notes.notes:
We published a new update for Fernbus Coach Simulator today which contains several improvements and additions. We finally implemented a mouse steering option and a steering camera which can be enabled or disabled in the options. We also implemented our first set of modding with repaints. You're able to select a new repaint based on the old branding design by MeinFernbus Flixbus and we also offer templates for creating own repaints on our forums. License plates can be created too when selecting your ride. Have fun!

[h1]Coach[/h1]
[list]
[*] White placeholder cube removed
[*] Headlight, fog light and long distance light updated
[*] Font size of current speed in display increased
[*] Steering camera implemented. The camera turns with the steering of the coach. Strength is configureable in the game settings menu.
[*] Look left/right keys turns the camera now instead of immediately switching it
[*] Camera centers automatically while driving (deactivatable in game settings)
[*] Raining into the back of the Lions Coach C fixed
[*] Repainting functionality added to the coaches
[*] Old "MeinFernbus Flixbus" design added as repaint, changable in the "Customize" menu
[*] License Plate added to the coach, changable in the "Customize" menu
[/list]

[h1]Traffic AI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Congestion at crossroad will now be detected to avoid blocking
[*] Braking behaviour updated
[*] Some materials of cars were changed
[/list]

[h1]Menu/HUD[/h1]
[list]
[*] Intro Video starts immediately at game start while loading. After Loading it is skippable
[*] Values in game settings menu are now displayed as 0-100 ranges instead of 0-1 ranges
[*] Back functionality is now triggered by escape key in most menus
[*] Menu music starts at finishing a route now too
[*] Additional information added to the navigation HUD: Current speed, current time, next stop, departure/arrival time
[*] Small design improvements in main menu
[/list]

[h1]Inputs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mouse steering added. Middle mouse button will activate it
[*] Preparations were added for auto configuration of input devices. Currently the database for devices is empty. Every time the inputs are applied in the menu a configuration file is written to disk. This file contains all informations for connected devices. You can find this file in "C:\Users\<your username>\AppData\Local\Fernbus\Settings\Devices". If you want you can send us this file to update the database.
[/list]

[h1]World[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reflective street signs will now be illuminated by the coach
[*] Some materials fixed
[*] Lighting of "Kölner Dom" fixed
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] A blendscreen was added when using timelaps or resetting the vehicle location
[*] "Continue" the route is now only available when starting at the current station
[*] The probability of events was increased
[/list]

notes.title: Patch note 02/09/2016
notes.notes:
Dear Steam Community,

since the Fernbus Coach Simulator release last Thursday the TML team has busy day and night addressing the unfortunately occurred problems. The information and crash dumps you’ve posted have been a tremendous help in tracking down and fixing these issues. Many thanks for your support! We’re glad to now release the first big patch, and hope that it improves the playing experience for all of you. It’s been a huge amount of work for our small team and we appreciate your patience and understanding. 

See below for the patch notes:

[b]Coaches[/b]
[list]
[*]Rain drops appear on the windscreen of the Lion's Coach
[*]Air Condition shows the correct temperasture after loading a savegame
[*]Sound of the doors is played correctly
[*]Sound of rain drops on the coaches roof added
[*]Announcement can now be deactivted at any time
[*]Engine ca no more be deactivated in Arcade-Mode
[/list]
[b]Passengers[/b]
[list]
[*]Passenger Voices added
[*]Subtitles fixed (Font color, Order and Flickering)
[*]Passengers comments appear pormptly
[*]Passenger comments (too slow) albeit maintaining speed limit of 60 km/h fixed
[/list]
[b]Menues[/b]
[list]
[*]Difficulty "Simple" (control mode) renamed "Arcade"
[*]Control Mode Dialogue added (Arcade or Realistic)
[*]Routen Editor: "Custom" renamed "Career"
[*]Game Mode Dialogue added (Career or Freeplay)
[*]FOV (Field of View) adjustability is reduced to inbetween 60° and 90°
[*]Main Menu background music added
[*]Loading Screen background image added
[*]Main Menu background images added
[*]Main Menu design slightly changed
[*]Two coaches in Menues fixed
[*]Added image for unlocked Cities in Route Editor
[*]Audio volumes fixed
[/list]
[b]Navigation[/b]
[list]
[*]Speed limits in Navigation fixed
[*]Speed limits and Distances in Freeplay disabled
[*]Navigation of the following Cities have been fixed: Konstanz, Augsburg, Saarbrücken, Halle
[*]Navigation starting from Depot fixed
[*]Speed limits for Frankfurt Airport, Berlin ZOB, Köln ZOB, München ZOB, Hamburg ZOB, Halle ZOB fixed
[/list]
[b]Languages[/b]
[list]
[*]Localisation fixed (English, German)
[/list]
[b]Inputs[/b]
[list]
[*]Simplification of Axis-Adjustment via presets (Standard, Standard 0-1, Inverterted, Inverterted 1-0)
[*]When adding a new Axis a preview helps with Adjustments
[*]Invalid (None) Inputs removed from Standard controls
[/list]
[b]Tooltips[/b]
[list]
[*]Tooltips updated
[*]Tooltip "Follow the navigation to..." will show up at Bus Stops and Offroad from now on
[/list]
[b]Profile[/b]
[list]
[*]Profile Setup updated
[*]Reseting a Profile will now show the Unlocks correctly
[/list]
[b]Statistics[/b]
[list]
[*]Driven kilometers will now show correctly
[/list]
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*]Some LODs (Levels of Detail) updated
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*]Certain Sound volumes updated
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.9142
notes.notes:
We've just released a Hotfix which should solve the following issues:

[h1]Crashes due to some input devices[/h1]

Some users had crashes, if certain input devices were connected or had been emulated via drivers. Those users should now be able to run the game.

[h1]AI Traffic at traffic lights[/h1]

The AI vehicles should stop correctly at red traffic lights.
